vibe_rationale: Deep, community-trusted custom chopper scene built around invited builders; large and sponsor-backed, but still culture-led.
fit_notes: Adult rider crowd at a hot, outdoor two-day show, where shade, hydration and recovery lounges fit naturally. Harley-Davidson presents, but more than 40 other partners mean a health brand would not stand alone. Weak wellness adjacency, and the event is US-based.
